Kanpur is one of North India's oldest and busiest industrial cities. The Jajmau belt runs one of Asia's largest leather and tannery clusters, and the Panki, Dada Nagar and Fazalganj estates carry chemicals, textiles, plastics, defence and heavy engineering. These are demanding environments — humidity, chemicals and dust — so the site offices they use need to be built for it. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; as a Container Office Supplier for Kanpur Factories we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Kanpur buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Kanpur

Leather and tannery units in the Jajmau belt use them as admin, accounts and QC cabins where a durable, easy-to-clean shell matters. Chemical, plastic and engineering units at Panki and Dada Nagar use them as supervisor and project offices. Defence and ordnance-linked contractors use them as documentation and security cabins. Builders on Kanpur's road, metro and infrastructure projects use them as construction site offices. The common need is a rugged unit that arrives finished and holds up in a tough industrial setting.

Kanpur industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial belts:

  • Panki Industrial Area (208020) — the large UPSIDC estate on the north-west side; chemicals, power, engineering and plastics; project and supervisor cabins.
  • Dada Nagar Industrial Area (208022) — plastics, packaging, auto components and light engineering; admin and site cabins.
  • Fazalganj Industrial Area (208012) — leather, footwear and engineering units; compact admin cabins.
  • Jajmau leather belt (208010) — the tannery and leather-processing cluster; durable, easy-clean admin and QC cabins.

Sites outside these pockets — Rooma, Rania or along the Kanpur ring road and GT Road — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Kanpur
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, admin cabin, QC/documentation room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

For a made-to-order requirement we can supply a prefabricated container office for industrial plots. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board — cement board suits chemical/leather-adjacent, high-humidity sites
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Most Kanpur orders are customised to the site. We can add: extra corrosion protection and cement-board panelling for the leather/chemical belt; partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; and ramps or external steps. For humid Jajmau and chemical-adjacent positions we advise on the panel and finish that lasts. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Kanpur

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Kanpur by road, around 440 km via the Yamuna and Agra–Lucknow Expressways — a fast, well-established corridor. Transit is typically 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve container offices we supply across Lucknow on the same route, so the line into central UP is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price, documentation and after-sales — which matters for leather, chemical and contractor onboarding. We supply across UP and North India, including container office supply for the Delhi region and container offices we deliver to Jaipur.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Kanpur depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel type (PUF vs cement board for humid/chemical sites), corrosion protection, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and transport. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Kanpur?

Price depends on size, panel type, corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

Which panel is better for a Kanpur leather or chemical site — PUF or cement board?

For humid, chemical or leather-adjacent sites we usually recommend cement-board panelling with extra corrosion protection, as it stands up better to moisture and cleaning. Tell us the site conditions and we advise on the right build.

How long does delivery take to Kanpur?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, around 440 km away via the Yamuna and Agra–Lucknow Expressways, with typical road transit of 3–5 days once the unit is built. We confirm the schedule at order stage based on your site and access.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Kanpur container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
